question: Motion to Waive All Applicable Budgetary Discipline Re: Sanders Amdt. No. 5159
bill_title: A concurrent resolution setting forth the congressional budget for the United States Government for fiscal year 2026 and setting forth the appropriate budgetary levels for fiscal years 2027 through 2035.
plain_language: This vote was on waiving budget rules so an amendment to S.Con.Res. 33 could be considered. The sponsor's official statement of purpose for the amendment: “To reduce the price of prescription drugs in the United States by more than 50 percent by adopting Most Favored Nation drug pricing so that the American people pay no more for prescription drugs than Europeans or Canadians.” Waiving needs 60 votes (three-fifths). A Yea supports the waiver; a Nay keeps the budget point of order in place, which blocks the amendment.
